description: A list of co-equal points in the writer's order, set in one column or, when the box is wide enough for two square-or-wider columns, in two columns filled down then across.

items: string, one point each, in reading order
data_schema._id: instance id prefix, set by the slide
data_schema.bullet_level: 0 (default), a deeper level, or null for no bullet

size_domain_emu.source: the size domain of the seed

variants.single_column: flex column of one text element per item, read straight down
variants.two_column: flex row of two flex columns of ceil(n/2) items, filled down the first column then across

variant_rule: the seed's rule: parts >= 2 and width // parts >= height, with parts = 2 columns
single_line_rule: none: every item is prose and may wrap
